newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 6.5 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 6.5 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.

text.p: Sweden's auction of 6.5 billion crowns worth of Treasury bills was oversubscribed, the National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate in an auction of three-month T-bills was 4.09 percent, the office said.
The office had invited bids for 500 million crowns and received 19 bids worth 3.48 billion crowns of which it accepted two.
An auction of six-month paper had an average accepted rate of 4.20 percent.
The office invited bids for 1.0 billion crowns and received 32 bids worth 4.96 billion crowns of which it accepted one.
The office said the accepted rate in an auction of one year paper worth 5.0 billion crowns was 4.49 percent.
It received 58 bids worth 6.72 billion crowns of which it accepted 47.
